construct_split_awa: construct a split AWA dataset with task labels and optional attribute file from image list files
construct_split_cub: construct a split CUB-200 bird dataset with task labels and optional attribute file from image list files
construct_split_cifar: construct a split CIFAR-10 or CIFAR-100 dataset with task labels for incremental learning tasks
construct_split_mnist: construct a split MNIST dataset with task labels partitioning digits across incremental learning tasks
construct_permute_mnist: construct a permuted MNIST dataset with a specified number of tasks each having unique pixel permutations
